description: Hi everyone!  We are Anshika Mathur, Anush Ramakrishna , Dhanush J , Dhruv Gupta , Sathwika Kulkarni and Vidhi, a team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about space, technology, creativity, and solving real-world problems. We’re looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills in coding, design, research, or data analysis who love sharing ideas and learning together. Let’s collaborate, innovate, and aim for the stars!
